program: v20 follow-up - registered measurement: matched-footprint perplexity frontier, additive count model vs trained tiny transformer on the constrained DSL (12 Aug 2026)
registered_in: analysis/ENGINEERING_PLAN_v20.md section B4b (completes the M131-disclosed transformer arm)

registration_notes.N92.1: Engineering MEASUREMENT milestone, not a claim audit and NOT a novelty claim. It completes the transformer arm M131 disclosed as not run (N90.6), producing a matched-footprint frontier.
registration_notes.N92.2: Question registered before measurement: on the deterministic constrained DSL, at each matched footprint (stored-model bytes), does the additive count model's test perplexity beat, tie, or lose to a genuinely trained tiny transformer of the same footprint? The outcome in the sub-hundreds-of-KB regime is not known without measuring.
registration_notes.N92.3: Count-model points are REUSED from the sealed M131 evidence (logs/results/v16/m131_additive_next_token/evidence.json), never recomputed. Transformer points are newly trained with fixed seeds and registered hyperparameters.
registration_notes.N92.4: Footprint = stored fp32 parameters (4 bytes/param), reported alongside fp16 (2 bytes/param). Matched-footprint comparison uses nearest transformer point to each count point; the interpolation method is disclosed.
registration_notes.N92.5: Transformer training is on the same train split as the count model (2.31M tokens, seed 900), same fixed test set (seed 902). Fixed torch seed; the run records the device and torch threads.
registration_notes.N92.6: The DSL is deterministic and highly structured; a small transformer may memorize its regularities at small footprint. Whether it matches the count model (which exploits the same structure) is the measured question. No prior expectation is registered as a gate.
registration_notes.N92.7: A surprise direction (count model dominating the transformer at matched footprint in the small regime) is reported as a measured fact if it occurs, with the footprint crossover point, not as a general claim about language modelling.
registration_notes.N92.8: Smoke runs use _smoke_note + _smoke_skip_gates and MUST refuse the sealed output dir.
registration_notes.N92.9: This evidence is a dated snapshot; it records the exact seeds, transformer hyperparameters, training steps, and device so a reader can repeat the measurement.
